text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh, no no no way, my skin's breaking out~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Why? Did I eat too many snacks?
I thought dates would be totally fine though~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it was covered in too much chocolate...?
Or was it the nuts you didn't like...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Urrgh, giving up snacks... I wonder if I can really do it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos ended up feeling down
due to her rough skin.
